success_stories.heading: Skilling Success Stories of Universities Across the Globe

items.title: Agile Methodologies Training Program at a Leading University in France

details.label: Objective
details.text: Equip MBA students with a comprehensive understanding of agile methodologies and their application in real-world business scenarios.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: Delivered in hybrid mode, which combined interactive online sessions, hands-on workshops, and group projects over several months.

details.label: Participants
details.text: 50+ MBA students from various specializations, including marketing, finance, and operations management.

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: Students learned various agile concepts like Scrum, Kanban, Lean Project Management, Agile Leadership, and Iterative Development Techniques. They applied these methodologies to manage academic projects more effectively and prepare for dynamic business environments.

quote.text: Edstellar's training significantly boosted our students' confidence and project management skills. We look forward to more such learning programs.
quote.name: Dr. Pierre Dupont

items.title: Cybersecurity and AI Fundamentals Training at a Leading Technology University in Germany

details.label: Objective
details.text: Equip engineering students with a solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and artificial intelligence fundamentals, and their practical applications in the industry.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: Delivered in hybrid mode, combining interactive online sessions, hands-on workshops, and group projects over several weeks.

details.label: Participants
details.text: 60+ engineering students from various branches, including computer science, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: Students learned key concepts through multiple courses within the cybersecurity and AI categories. These included network security, ethical hacking, threat management, machine learning, neural networks, and data analysis. The knowledge helped enhance their technical competencies and prepare for innovative roles in the industry.

quote.text: Edstellar's training significantly boosted our students' skills and innovative thinking. We look forward to more collaborations.
quote.name: Dr. Anna Müller

items.title: Soft Skills and Behavioral Skills Development Program at a Renowned University in Singapore

details.label: Objective
details.text: Skill development courses for teachers and staff members aimed to strengthen soft skills and behavioral competencies and improve workplace communication, teamwork, and overall professional effectiveness.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: Delivered through interactive on-site training sessions, hands-on workshops, and role-playing exercises over a three-week period.

details.label: Participants
details.text: 70+ staff members from various departments, including administration, research, and student services.

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: The training programs for teachers and staff members developed key soft skills such as effective communication, conflict resolution, emotional intelligence, and time management. They also enhanced their behavioral skills in areas like teamwork, leadership, and adaptability.

quote.text: Edstellar's training was instrumental in improving our staff's communication and teamwork. We saw immediate benefits in workplace dynamics
quote.name: Mr. John Tan
